projects.name: BuildResumeNow
projects.description: A full-stack AI-powered resume builder that leverages generative AI to help users craft professional resumes in minutes. Built as an independent product with end-to-end ownership from ideation through deployment and user acquisition. The platform combines template-driven design with smart AI suggestions to personalize content for different roles and industries.
projects.outcomes: Successfully shipped to market with organic user acquisition and sustained user engagement. Demonstrates full product lifecycle ownership: user research → feature prioritization → deployment → iteration based on user feedback. Generated sustainable revenue through SaaS model with recurring user base.

projects.name: SaarthiX
projects.description: A Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that turns any webpage into a multilingual voice assistant for India's next billion internet users. Users speak to any page and get it explained aloud in their own language, with an agentic tool-use loop letting the LLM pull page context (headings, sections, targeted text) before answering, plus voice-driven, conversational form-filling backed by a locally encrypted user profile.
projects.outcomes: Led and developed the core voice loop with a 3-person team using clearly owned module contracts: mic capture, page-aware speech-to-text, agentic reasoning, and text-to-speech working end-to-end, plus a working voice-driven form-fill flow. Evolved the product from a browser extension into an embeddable widget portals can integrate and pay for, keeping the extension as a live sales demo.

projects.name: Parakh
projects.description: A stock-market companion app for Indian retail investors that turns the daily flood of BSE/NSE corporate filings into the few that matter. A pipeline ingests announcements from both exchanges' undocumented feeds into an append-only raw store, normalizes the two very different formats, and classifies each filing into 26 event types with a versioned rules engine (so an LLM classifier can later be compared side by side on identical rows). Around it sits a FastAPI backend (watchlists, paper portfolios, price alerts, split-adjusted price history, company fundamentals, F&O chain, push notifications, broker trade-file import) and a Flutter mobile app with a stock detail page, portfolio and a filing feed. Built solo, end to end.
projects.outcomes: Working end to end against both live exchange feeds: on a single trading day (11 Sep 2026) it ingested 1,343 announcements across 959 securities and flagged 27% as potentially price-moving, separating them from routine filings like trading-window closures. Backend is deployed on Render and an Android build is in private beta with friends. 220+ commits since September 2026, still in active development.

projects.name: LinkedIn Automation Agent
projects.description: A self-running LinkedIn content pipeline that scouts engineering blogs from top Indian tech companies, rewrites the best ones into first-person LinkedIn posts in my own voice, and auto-publishes them with the source link dropped as the first comment to protect feed reach. Built as a custom multi-agent pipeline: Curator (scores relevance/angle) → Writer (drafts in-persona) → Critic (checklist review with hard-ban retries) → Mix Governor (prevents topic flooding) → Uniqueness Checker (RAG-style semantic dedup via sentence-transformer embeddings against post history), before anything goes live. Actively iterating: currently on v2 of the pipeline after multiple rounds of prompt and guardrail tuning.
projects.outcomes: Fully automated, guardrailed content pipeline that sources, writes, critiques, and publishes LinkedIn posts with zero manual editing, currently in active development with ongoing fine-tuning of the Critic and Uniqueness gates to improve post quality and reduce repetition.

projects.name: Infraon - AIOps (Intelligent Events Platform)
projects.description: AIOps is an enterprise-grade intelligent event management platform designed to reduce network noise and automate root cause analysis across complex infrastructures. As a Senior Backend Developer and Team Lead, I architected and lead development for predictive alerting, automated RCA (Root Cause Analysis), and advanced observability. Core work includes: (1) Time-series forecasting (Facebook Prophet, XGBoost) for anomaly detection, (2) Hybrid RAG-powered root cause analysis combining historical incident embeddings with semantic search to match current events to similar past incidents, enabling LLM-driven causal inference, (3) Stream processing pipelines ingesting millions of telemetry events daily from Kafka/RabbitMQ, (4) Vector database integration (pgvector/Qdrant) for semantic similarity queries across incident histories. Currently expanding RCA with multi-modal RAG: embedding incident narratives, metrics, and topology data to deliver contextual root cause hypotheses in sub-second latency.
projects.outcomes: Delivered intelligent event noise reduction and automated RCA tools adopted by major Indian enterprises, resulting in 35% improvement in incident response times and 60% reduction in mean-time-to-resolve (MTTR). RAG-powered RCA currently in beta, showing 4-5x faster root cause identification vs. traditional alerting.
